preconditions.description: The number of rows on the board is between 1 and 200, inclusive.
The number of columns on the board is between 1 and 200, inclusive.
The number of chips is between 1 and 200, inclusive.
The starting row of the i-th chip is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The starting column of the i-th chip is between 1 and m, inclusive.
The target row of the i-th chip is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The target column of the i-th chip is between 1 and m, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is between 1 and 2nm, or -1 if it's not possible.
The sequence of operations is exactly as long as the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(char in 'LRUD' for char in output_line_2)
postconditions.description: Each character in the sequence of operations is one of L, R, U, D.

postconditions.expression: is_possible(output_line_2, n, m, k, sx_i, sy_i, fx_i, fy_i)
postconditions.description: The sequence of operations is valid for the given board size, number of chips, starting positions, and target positions.

invariants.description: The board has at least as many cells as there are chips.
Petya can only perform up to 2nm actions.
